say:1:1322125001:1.text: The exit of the secret passage can't be opened... I can detect a seal of Divine Light.
say:1:1322125001:1.source_cn: 密道的出口……打不开了，我能感觉到有圣光封印的力量。

say:2:1322125002:1.text: Chippy can't believe they actually sealed off the passage! Are they really that terrified of the undead? What a bunch of cowards! And they dare call themselves acolytes of Dura!
say:2:1322125002:1.source_cn: 那些修士和修女果然把密道给封死了！他们就这么害怕亡灵吗...

say:3:1322125003:1.text: Don't be too hard on them, Sir Chippy. I understand their fear. If a Hypogean claiming to be good asked for my help, I'd feel scared and unsure as well.
say:3:1322125003:1.source_cn: 满满先生，请不要责怪他们，我能理解他们的惊慌。如果有一...

say:4:1322125004:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please help dispel the seal?
say:4:1322125004:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please help dispel the seal?
say:4:1322125004:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please help dispel the seal?

choice_prompt:5:1322125004.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please help dispel the seal?
choice_prompt:5:1322125004.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，能麻烦你们和我一起将这个封印解除吗？
choice_prompt:5:1322125004.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please help dispel the seal?
choice_prompt:5:1322125004.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please help dispel the seal?

narration:6:1322125005:1.text: A cluster of magical light flickers and fades as you silently undo the seal guarding the exit of the secret passage. The air grows still. The path forward is open.
